ambiguities.fragment: enters the access card with the access code
ambiguities.explanation: The prepositional phrase 'with the access code' can attach either to the verb 'enters' (indicating the method of entry) or to the noun phrase 'the access card' (indicating a property of the card), resulting in two distinct syntactic trees and meanings.
possible_interpretations: The user performs the action of entering by using the access code (the code is the means of entry).
The user enters an access card that possesses the access code (the card contains or is associated with the code).
textual_evidence: enters the access card with the access code
